description: What changed on an entity's record between two days: its state on from against its state on to (today when omitted), compared by claim. added: facts held on to and not on from. ended: held on from, not on to, and not replaced. replaced: the same predicate with another value, the claim that held on from beside the one that holds on to (paired by the record's superseded_by pointer, when the predicate has exactly one of each and the new value begins the day the old one ends, or when the predicate has one holder at a time, such as ceo, chair, cfo or headquarters, and one holder ended while another began). unchanged counts the claims held on both days; by_predicate gives each predicate's counts; summary is the one sentence the page /record/{slug}/diff leads with: quote it. Rows carry the fields entity_state rows carry; added rows are labelled for to, ended rows for from. Posts and Hugging Face repos are counted (skipped_posts), not listed: changes_since lists them. counts, by_predicate and summary cover the whole diff; the rows are paged in the order replaced, added, ended (limit default 50, max 200; offset pages; complete: false and next_offset say there is more). group: true reads the entity's company group (as in entity_state), each row naming its record. from must be before to.

detail.description: compact: each row is id, predicate, value, qualifier, the dates it held, status, why_not when the record does not assert it, and the primary source URL: about a fifth the size, so a page holds five times the rows. Left out: published, recorded, confidence, citation, evidence (each is on the claim page, https://asof.is/claim/{id}, or the claim tool). full (the default): every field.

from.description: The earlier day, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD

group.description: Compare the entity's company group (Google with Alphabet, Google DeepMind, Gemini...)

limit.description: Rows per page across replaced, added and ended (max 200)

offset.description: Skip this many rows (next_offset from the previous page)

to.description: The later day, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; today when omitted

name: entity_diff

complete.description: false when rows remain: ask again with next_offset

legend.description: What the row fields and why_not codes mean

page.description: The page on asof.is that states the same answer

summary.description: What changed between the two days, as one sentence to quote

title: Entity diff between two dates
